package sqlintegration

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/matrixorigin/matrixone/pkg/embed"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestLoomJSONLineBinaryPublicRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	runSQLIntegration(t, func(c embed.Cluster) {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(t.Context(), 90*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		cn, err := c.GetCNService(0)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		defer cleanupSQLIntegration(t, cn, "drop database if exists loom_json_binary_cas")
		db, err := sql.Open("mysql", fmt.Sprintf("dump:111@tcp(127.0.0.1:%d)/", cn.GetServiceConfig().CN.Frontend.Port))
		require.NoError(t, err)
		defer db.Close()
		conn, err := db.Conn(ctx)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		defer conn.Close()
		exec := func(t *testing.T, q string) {
			t.Helper()
			_, err := conn.ExecContext(ctx, q)
			require.NoError(t, err, q)
		}
		exec(t, "create database loom_json_binary_cas")
		exec(t, "use loom_json_binary_cas")
		exec(t, "create table src(id int primary key,b varbinary(8),txt varchar(8))")
		exec(t, "insert into src values(1,unhex('00FF'),'AP8='),(2,unhex('5C4E'),'test'),(3,unhex(''),''),(4,NULL,NULL)")
		path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "binary.jsonl")
		exec(t, "select id,b,txt from src into outfile '"+path+"' format 'jsonline'")
		data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		exported := map[int]map[string]any{}
		for _, line := range strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(string(data)), "\n") {
			var row map[string]any
			require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &row))
			id, ok := row["id"].(float64)
			require.True(t, ok)
			exported[int(id)] = row
		}
		require.Len(t, exported, 4)
		for id, payload := range map[int]string{1: "AP8=", 2: "XE4=", 3: ""} {
			require.Equal(t, map[string]any{"$binary": payload}, exported[id]["b"])
		}
		require.Nil(t, exported[4]["b"])
		require.Equal(t, "AP8=", exported[1]["txt"])
		exec(t, "create table dst like src")
		plain := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "plain.jsonl")
		require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(plain, []byte("{\"id\":5,\"b\":\"test\",\"txt\":\"ok\"}\n"), 0600))
		invalid := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "invalid.jsonl")
		require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(invalid, []byte("{\"id\":6,\"b\":{\"$binary\":\"***\"},\"txt\":\"bad\"}\n"), 0600))
		for _, parallel := range []string{"false", "true"} {
			t.Run("parallel="+parallel, func(t *testing.T) {
				exec(t, "truncate table dst")
				exec(t, "load data infile{'filepath'='"+path+"','format'='jsonline','jsondata'='object'} into table dst parallel '"+parallel+"' strict 'true'")
				func() {
					rows, err := conn.QueryContext(ctx, "select id,hex(b),b is null,txt from dst order by id")
					require.NoError(t, err)
					defer rows.Close()
					count := 0
					for rows.Next() {
						count++
						var id int
						var hex, txt sql.NullString
						var isNull bool
						require.NoError(t, rows.Scan(&id, &hex, &isNull, &txt))
						require.Equal(t, count, id)
						if id == 4 {
							require.True(t, isNull)
							require.False(t, hex.Valid)
							require.False(t, txt.Valid)
						} else {
							require.False(t, isNull)
							require.True(t, hex.Valid)
							require.Equal(t, []string{"00FF", "5C4E", ""}[id-1], hex.String)
							require.True(t, txt.Valid)
							require.Equal(t, []string{"AP8=", "test", ""}[id-1], txt.String)
						}
					}
					require.NoError(t, rows.Err())
					require.Equal(t, 4, count)
				}()
				exec(t, "load data infile{'filepath'='"+plain+"','format'='jsonline','jsondata'='object'} into table dst parallel '"+parallel+"' strict 'true'")
				var got string
				require.NoError(t, conn.QueryRowContext(ctx, "select hex(b) from dst where id=5").Scan(&got))
				require.Equal(t, "74657374", got)
				_, err := conn.ExecContext(ctx, "load data infile{'filepath'='"+invalid+"','format'='jsonline','jsondata'='object'} into table dst parallel '"+parallel+"' strict 'true'")
				require.ErrorContains(t, err, "$binary")
				var count int
				require.NoError(t, conn.QueryRowContext(ctx, "select count(*) from dst").Scan(&count))
				require.Equal(t, 5, count)
			})
		}
	})
}
